source: STEER Project (Save the Children, iDE Cambodia, and the Cambodian Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries) - "Guide on Banana Cultivation Techniques" (សៀវភៅណែនាំស្តីអំពី បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះដំណាំចេក), February 2020
text:
Chek Pong Moan (ចេកពងមាន់, literally "chicken-egg banana") produces small, rounded fruit that ripens to a golden yellow, with bunches whose individual fingers resemble a cluster of eggs - the source of its Khmer name. It is a commercially recognized variety valued for its eating quality.

Chek Pong Moan is one of the three Cambodian varieties used as a local benchmark ("local check") in national banana variety trials conducted by the Prek Leap National School of Agriculture, where it was compared for growth and yield against a set of internationally sourced accessions.
